findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Describe (or cite the shard ticket for) what the amendments to ADR 0028/0055/0031/0035 must add, so the ADR-first criterion maps to described work in the plan body.
evidence: AC: 'Every ADR enumerated in the shard tickets (the new ADRs and the amendments to ADR 0028/0055/0031/0035) EXISTS AND IS COMMITTED'
Body: '~13 new ADRs are proposed across the shards' — no mention of amendments to existing ADRs 0028/0055/0031/0035
findings.finding: The superseding AC requires committing 'amendments to ADR 0028/0055/0031/0035' but the plan body never describes these four amendments; only '~13 new ADRs' are discussed narratively, so the criterion references described-nowhere deliverables.
scenarios: An executor reads the ADR-first AC and cannot tell what the four ADR amendments must contain because the body describes only new ADRs

findings.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an ab77 AC that names signing.py (root-level, in ab77 scope) and preserves the parent's negative result: its replay/security-invariant comments are DO_NOT_MOVE (verbatim), only the ~5-8 trivially-recoverable lines are recovered, and the file is NOT size-fixed by comment triage.
evidence: Parent body: 'comment triage cannot fix three files. _store/event_append.py (791) recovers ~10 lines; reducer/_processors.py (777) recovers ~3; signing.py (798) recovers ~5-8. Their comments ARE the replay-compat and security invariants.'

signing.py resolves to src/rebar/signing.py (root-level), which is inside ab77's declared scope 'root-level src/rebar/*.py plus attest/, metrics/, review_bot/, opcert_service/, audit/, grounding/, _guides/'.
Verified src/rebar/signing.py exists with provenance/security-invariant docstrings (e.g. _gate_source_dir, _baked_commit_sha, rebar_version_from_manifest citing epic jira-reb-596).

ab77 child text: 'this scope is in good health and the yield is concentrated' and enumerates only _mcp_models.py, _mcp_llm.py, _config_schema.py, review_bot/ — signing.py appears nowhere in ab77's body or superseding ACs.
da4c, by contrast, carries an explicit 'NEGATIVE RESULT preserved' AC for its two size-pressured files (event_append.py 791/800, _processors.py 777/800).
findings.finding: The parent's NEGATIVE RESULT names signing.py (798/800) as one of three size-pressured files whose comments ARE load-bearing (security) invariants and cannot be recovered beyond ~5-8 lines, but the owning child ab77 (whose scope is root-level src/rebar/*.py, which contains signing.py) never names signing.py and frames its entire scope as 'in good health and the yield is concentrated'. The parent's negative-result contract for signing.py is not carried by any child, unlike the parallel event_append.py/_processors.py case which da4c explicitly preserves.
scenarios: An implementer executing ab77, seeing 'good health / concentrated yield' and no signing.py callout, treats signing.py's ~798 lines as ordinary relocation surface and strips replay/security-invariant prose to chase headroom — the exact loss the parent's negative result exists to prevent.

A completion verifier checks the parent's negative-result claim (signing.py cannot be size-fixed; its comments stay) and finds no child AC that asserts or protects it, so the parent claim is unverifiable against the shard that owns the file.
findings.suggested_fix: Mirror da4c's NEGATIVE-RESULT AC in ab77: 'signing.py (798/800) is NOT size-fixed by comment triage — its comments are security/provenance invariants (DO_NOT_MOVE, verbatim); recover only trivially-recoverable lines, do not strip load-bearing rationale to chase headroom.'

findings.finding: Parent AC 'Each shard MEASURES and RECORDS on its own ticket the actual comment lines it recovered' is uncovered for five of six children - only 9ce8 carries a measure-and-record AC.
findings.suggested_fix: Append to each of the five children's ACs the 9ce8-style line: 'The ACTUAL recovered comment-line count is measured (by diff line-count) and recorded on this ticket.'

findings.finding: Parent AC 'Every ADR enumerated in the shard tickets EXISTS AND IS COMMITTED before any comment that will cite it is collapsed' is uncovered for five of six children - only 9ce8 carries a destination-first ADR-ordering AC, yet 4b94, 4fc1, ad16 and ab77 each propose new ADRs to be cited.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the 9ce8 AC verbatim to 4b94, 4fc1, ad16 and ab77: 'Each new ADR and each amendment EXISTS AND IS COMMITTED before any comment that will cite it is collapsed or deleted -- destination first, then the relocation.'

findings.finding: Parent AC2 (each shard MEASURES and RECORDS on its own ticket the actual comment lines it recovered) is covered by only one of six children. Only 9ce8's corrected AC ('The ACTUAL recoverable line count is measured and recorded on this ticket') delivers the measure-and-record outcome. The other five children (4b94, 4fc1, ab77, ad16, da4c) have no acceptance criterion requiring measurement or recording of recovered lines.
findings.suggested_fix: Replicate 9ce8's 'measured and recorded on this ticket' AC into the other five children so the parent can aggregate the net total.

findings.finding: Parent AC3 (every enumerated ADR and amendment EXISTS AND IS COMMITTED before any citing comment is collapsed — destination-first) is covered by only one of six children. Four children propose NEW ADRs to serve as citation destinations — 4b94 (web-search capabilities ADR), 4fc1 ('Explicit init over silent-implicit tracker creation'), ab77 (three review_bot ADRs), ad16 (three ADRs incl. attestation manifest, Burr tripwire, gate-context) — yet none of those four carry an AC gating comment collapse on the ADR existing first. Only 9ce8's corrected AC states the destination-first ordering for its ADRs/amendments.
findings.suggested_fix: Copy 9ce8's destination-first ADR AC into 4b94, 4fc1, ab77, and ad16 against each shard's own enumerated ADR set.

findings.finding: The parent AC requiring each shard to MEASURE and RECORD the actual recovered comment-line count on its own ticket is delivered by only one sibling (9ce8). The other five shards' acceptance criteria do not include a measure-and-record obligation.
findings.suggested_fix: Append to 4b94, 4fc1, ad16, da4c, and ab77 the same measure-and-record AC 9ce8 carries, framed as an output not a target.

findings.finding: The parent AC requiring every enumerated new ADR / amendment to EXIST AND BE COMMITTED before any citing comment is collapsed ('destination first, then relocation') is delivered by only one sibling (9ce8). The other five shards each propose new ADRs but carry no ADR-ordering AC.
findings.suggested_fix: Copy 9ce8's 'destination first, then relocation' ADR-ordering AC into the other five shard tickets, scoped to each shard's own enumerated ADR set.

findings.finding: Destination-first / consumer-impact gap for DOC homes (analogous to the ADR gap but not covered by parent AC3, which enumerates only ADRs). 4fc1 relocates ~126 lines of stale bash-migration prose to docs/bash-migration.md; ab77 states docs/config.md rows must be WRITTEN FIRST before trimming _config_schema.py or 'the trim destroys documentation'; da4c notes docs/event-schema.md is a PARTIAL, STALE copy ('two homes, one drifting'). None of these three children carry an AC gating the comment collapse/relocation on the destination doc existing and being complete first.
findings.suggested_fix: Generalise parent AC3 (and the relevant children) from 'ADR' to 'ADR or documentation destination' so doc relocations are gated destination-first too.

findings.finding: Parent AC 'History that already cites a ticket is reduced to the citation; history citing none has a ticket filed first' is uncovered by every child - no sibling's ACs mention filing a ticket for untracked history before collapse, though ad16 flags untracked follow-ups that 'must be filed first'.
findings.suggested_fix: Add to each child: 'History that already cites a ticket is reduced to the citation; history citing none has a ticket filed first (destination before collapse).'

findings.finding: Parent AC 'No behaviour change: the full test suite AND make lint / make typecheck pass unchanged across every shard' with pragmas and introspected docstrings on every shard's do_not_move list is uncovered for five children and scope-narrowed for 9ce8.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the parent's full behaviour-change AC (test suite + make lint + make typecheck pass; pragmas and introspected docstrings on do_not_move) to all six children, replacing 9ce8's narrowed 'reconciler's tests pass unchanged'.

findings.finding: Parent AC4 (history that already cites a ticket is reduced to the citation; history citing none has a ticket filed first) is uncovered — no child's acceptance criteria deliver it. Child bodies discuss it (ad16: '36 of 38 history blocks already cite a ticket ... two costly untracked follow-ups that must be filed first'; 4b94: '85 lines are free wins — history already citing b690...'; 9ce8: history reductions) but none of the six children's AC lists contain a history-to-citation-or-file-ticket criterion. Child AC (a) 'relocated or deleted per its destination' is a related/precursor outcome, not the same measurable outcome.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the parent's AC4 wording as an explicit criterion on each of the six children.

findings.finding: Parent AC8 (no behaviour change: full test suite AND make lint/typecheck pass unchanged across every shard; and pragma comments plus introspected docstrings go on every shard's do_not_move list) is only partially and narrowly covered. Only 9ce8 has any test AC and it is scope-narrowed to 'the reconciler's tests pass unchanged' (tests only, not lint/typecheck). No child AC mentions make lint / make typecheck, and NO child AC lists inline pragma comments (# noqa, # type: ignore, # ruff:, # tickets-boundary-ok) or test-introspected docstrings as load-bearing / do_not_move members.
findings.suggested_fix: Copy the parent's AC8 (including the pragma/introspected-docstring clause) onto all six children, broadening 9ce8's tests-only AC to include lint/typecheck.

findings.finding: The parent AC 'No behaviour change: the full test suite passes unchanged across every shard' is covered by only one sibling. 9ce8 carries 'No behaviour change: the reconciler's tests pass unchanged'; the other five shards carry no test-passing / no-behaviour-change AC at all.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 9ce8's no-behaviour-change AC (scoped to each shard's touched subtree, or the full suite) to the other five shard tickets.
